clues.text: This city stands where a river valley cuts the edge of the high plains. A great wall of rocky peaks rises just west of its streets.
clues.narrowing: Rules out lowland towns; puts the player on high plains just east of rocky peaks.

source.quote: located in the South Platte River valley on the western edge of the High Plains, and is just east of the Front Range of the Rocky Mountains (Rockies)

clues.text: Winter here swings between deep snow with bitter cold and mild, soft days. Warm winds, called Chinooks, slide in and break the cold spell.
clues.narrowing: Rules out steady winters; keeps wild swings warmed by Chinook winds.

source.quote: Winters consist of periods of snow and very low temperatures alternating with periods of milder weather due to the warming effect of Chinook winds

clues.text: This gold town won the chief job for its territory in 1867. In 1881, a vote of the whole state made it the state capital for good.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals confirmed by a statewide vote in 1881.

source.quote: Denver was made the permanent state capital in a 1881 Colorado state capital referendum

clues.text: Outside the west door of the capitol, the fifteenth step is carved with words that name its height. Stand on that step and you stand one full mile high.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: just one capitol has a fifteenth step that marks a full mile high.

source.quote: outside the west entrance to the building, where the fifteenth step is engraved with the words "One Mile Above Sea Level"

clues.text: The laws of Colorado are made in this city. It is the state capital, and the state's largest city too.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the governor and lawmakers of the state work in this city.

source.quote: is the capital and most populous city of the U.S. state of Colorado

reveal.blurb: Gold seekers founded Denver where two streams meet in 1858, and a vote in 1881 made it the lasting state capital. One mile up, its capitol building serves the state: the building is the capitol, and the city is the capital. Denver is the capital of Colorado.
